analytic_block_switch_lemma.conclusion: For every q <= the uniform bound with gcd(q,6)=1, the unconstrained authoritative fixed-(N,M) tail-numerator and endpoint residue sets are all of Z/qZ.
analytic_block_switch_lemma.coverage: There are q equal unit increments at i=0,t,...,(q-1)t; switching s=0,...,q-1 of them covers every residue.
analytic_block_switch_lemma.euler_uniform_bound_reason: ord_q(4*3^(-1)) <= phi(q) <= q-1, so q(q-1) <= min(M,N-M) suffices.
analytic_block_switch_lemma.statement: For a=4*3^(-1) mod q and t=ord_q(a), k=q*t blocks chosen independently as 10 or 01 have fixed length 2k and weight k and attain every Q residue modulo q.
analytic_block_switch_lemma.switch_increment: Changing block i from 10 to 01 adds c_i=4^i*3^(k-1-i); c_(i+t)=c_i mod q.

extension_lemma.statement: If fixed-weight prefixes (h,r) attain every residue modulo q, then fixed (N,M) words attain every residue whenever M>=r and N-M>=h-r.

scope.consequence: Surjectivity here is only a blindness result for an unconstrained relaxation, not for legal H21 continuations.
